notes: The current file was a potrace of a black circle, not Axonaut's colours. The kit's blue is #1464B1; the axonaut.com favicon still shows the mark in white on an older navy tile. The kit ships logos only as PNG and PDF (no SVG), so the SVG is a lossless pdftocairo conversion of the kit's vector PDF (the extracted PDFs are kept in src5/'Logo - PDF'). The kit also has a white-on-blue square version (axonaut-fondbleu-icon); I shipped the bare mark since the square is a full-bleed background, not a rounded app tile. Blue reads on both themes.
